ABOUT.HERO.TITLE: Where Intelligence Meets Interior Design
ABOUT.HERO.SUBTITLE: We are redefining the furniture shopping experience by blending cutting-edge artificial intelligence with premium craftsmanship. Discover a smarter way to design your space.
ABOUT.STORY.TITLE: Crafting the Future of Interior Living
ABOUT.STORY.DESCRIPTION: FurniMind AI was born from a simple vision: to make premium furniture accessible, intelligent, and deeply personal. We combine AI-driven spatial design with handpicked craftsmanship to transform how you experience your home.
ABOUT.STORY.LABEL: Our Story
ABOUT.STORY.CONTENT: Founded in 2023, FurniMind AI emerged from the intersection of spatial computing and interior design. Our team of engineers, designers, and artisans worked tirelessly to build a platform that understands not just your style, but your actual physical space — delivering furniture recommendations that fit perfectly, every time.
ABOUT.MISSION.LABEL: Our Mission
ABOUT.MISSION.CONTENT: To democratize premium interior design by leveraging AI to analyze room dimensions, lighting, and architectural features — then curate furniture collections that harmonize with your space. We believe everyone deserves a home that feels tailor-made.
ABOUT.VISION.LABEL: Our Vision
ABOUT.VISION.CONTENT: A world where technology and design exist in perfect harmony. We envision an ecosystem where your living space becomes a living canvas — continuously learning, adapting, and evolving with your lifestyle through the power of spatial artificial intelligence.
ABOUT.VALUES.TITLE: Our Core Values
ABOUT.VALUES.INNOVATION.TITLE: Innovation First
ABOUT.VALUES.INNOVATION.DESCRIPTION: We push the boundaries of what's possible in home design by combining AI, computer vision, and premium curation to create experiences never seen before in furniture retail.
ABOUT.VALUES.AI_POWERED.TITLE: AI-Powered Experience
ABOUT.VALUES.AI_POWERED.DESCRIPTION: Our spatial AI engine scans and understands your room dimensions, lighting conditions, and architectural layout to recommend furniture that fits perfectly and looks stunning.
ABOUT.VALUES.CUSTOMER_FIRST.TITLE: Customer First
ABOUT.VALUES.CUSTOMER_FIRST.DESCRIPTION: Every feature we build, every product we curate, and every interaction we design starts with one question: how does this make our customer's life better?
ABOUT.VALUES.SECURE.TITLE: Secure Shopping
ABOUT.VALUES.SECURE.DESCRIPTION: Your privacy and security are paramount. We use enterprise-grade encryption and comply with global data protection standards to ensure your information stays safe.
ABOUT.VALUES.SMART_RECOMMENDATIONS.TITLE: Smart Recommendations
ABOUT.VALUES.SMART_RECOMMENDATIONS.DESCR: Our AI learns your preferences over time, delivering increasingly accurate suggestions that match your aesthetic, budget, and spatial constraints.
ABOUT.VALUES.MODERN_MARKETPLACE.TITLE: Modern Marketplace
ABOUT.VALUES.MODERN_MARKETPLACE.DESCRIPT: A curated marketplace connecting you with premium vendors, artisans, and designers — all verified for quality, authenticity, and craftsmanship.
ABOUT.STATS.TITLE: FurniMind by the Numbers
ABOUT.PRIVACY.TITLE: Privacy Policy
ABOUT.PRIVACY.DESCRIPTION: We are committed to protecting your personal information and being transparent about how we collect, use, and safeguard your data.
ABOUT.PRIVACY.DATA_COLLECTION.TITLE: Data Collection
ABOUT.PRIVACY.DATA_COLLECTION.DESCRIPTIO: We collect information you provide directly, such as your name, email address, phone number, shipping address, and payment details when you create an account, place an order, or contact our support team. We also automatically collect certain data about your device and browsing behavior, including IP address, browser type, pages visited, and time spent on our platform — all to improve your shopping experience.
ABOUT.PRIVACY.ACCOUNT_INFO.TITLE: Account Information
ABOUT.PRIVACY.ACCOUNT_INFO.DESCRIPTION: Your account information is stored securely and used to process orders, personalize your recommendations, and communicate with you about your purchases. You can update or delete your account information at any time through your profile settings. We never sell your personal data to third parties.
ABOUT.PRIVACY.COOKIES.TITLE: Cookies Usage
ABOUT.PRIVACY.COOKIES.DESCRIPTION: We use cookies and similar tracking technologies to enhance your browsing experience, analyze site traffic, and understand where our visitors come from. You can control cookie preferences through your browser settings. Essential cookies are required for the platform to function properly, while analytics and marketing cookies can be opted out.
ABOUT.PRIVACY.ANALYTICS.TITLE: Analytics Usage
ABOUT.PRIVACY.ANALYTICS.DESCRIPTION: We use analytics tools to understand how our customers interact with FurniMind AI. This helps us improve our AI recommendations, optimize the user interface, and identify popular products and design trends. All analytics data is aggregated and anonymized — individual user behavior is never exposed.
ABOUT.PRIVACY.SECURITY.TITLE: Security Measures
ABOUT.PRIVACY.SECURITY.DESCRIPTION: We implement industry-standard security measures including SSL/TLS encryption for all data transmissions, PCI-DSS compliant payment processing, regular security audits, and strict access controls. Our infrastructure is hosted on secure, SOC 2 compliant cloud servers with 24/7 monitoring.
ABOUT.PRIVACY.USER_RIGHTS.TITLE: User Rights
ABOUT.PRIVACY.USER_RIGHTS.DESCRIPTION: You have the right to access, correct, or delete your personal data at any time. You can download your data, restrict processing, object to certain uses, and request portability. To exercise any of these rights, visit your account settings or contact our Data Protection Officer at privacy@furnimind.ai.
ABOUT.TERMS.TITLE: Terms & Conditions
ABOUT.TERMS.DESCRIPTION: Please read these terms carefully before using the FurniMind AI platform. By accessing our services, you agree to be bound by these conditions.
ABOUT.TERMS.USAGE.TITLE: Platform Usage
ABOUT.TERMS.USAGE.DESCRIPTION: By accessing FurniMind AI, you confirm that you are at least 18 years of age or accessing under the supervision of a parent or guardian. You agree to use the platform for lawful purposes only and in accordance with these terms. You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your account credentials and for all activities that occur under your account.
ABOUT.TERMS.RESPONSIBILITIES.TITLE: User Responsibilities
ABOUT.TERMS.RESPONSIBILITIES.DESCRIPTION: As a user, you agree to provide accurate and complete information when creating an account or placing an order. You must not impersonate others, misrepresent your identity, or use the platform for any fraudulent or unauthorized purpose. You are responsible for ensuring that your use of the platform complies with all applicable local, national, and international laws.
ABOUT.TERMS.PAYMENTS.TITLE: Orders & Payments
ABOUT.TERMS.PAYMENTS.DESCRIPTION: All orders are subject to availability and acceptance. Prices are displayed in the selected currency and may include applicable taxes. Payment is processed securely through our trusted payment gateways. We reserve the right to cancel any order if fraudulent activity is suspected or if the product is no longer available.
ABOUT.TERMS.REFUNDS.TITLE: Refunds & Returns
ABOUT.TERMS.REFUNDS.DESCRIPTION: We offer a 30-day return policy for most items in their original condition and packaging. Custom-made or personalized items may be subject to different return conditions. Refunds are processed within 5-10 business days after we receive the returned item. Shipping costs for returns are the responsibility of the customer unless the item is defective or incorrect.
ABOUT.TERMS.SECURITY.TITLE: Account Security
ABOUT.TERMS.SECURITY.DESCRIPTION: You are responsible for safeguarding the password and any other authentication credentials used to access your account. You agree to notify us immediately of any unauthorized use of your account. We are not liable for any loss or damage arising from your failure to protect your account credentials.
ABOUT.TERMS.LEGAL.TITLE: Legal Information
ABOUT.TERMS.LEGAL.DESCRIPTION: These terms are governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the Arab Republic of Egypt. Any disputes arising from these terms shall be resolved through arbitration in Cairo, Egypt. FurniMind AI reserves the right to update these terms at any time, with changes effective upon posting to the platform. Continued use after changes constitutes acceptance of the new terms.
ABOUT.CTA.TITLE: Ready to Transform Your Space?
ABOUT.CTA.SUBTITLE: Our team is here to help you every step of the way. Whether you need design advice, order assistance, or just want to say hello — we would love to hear from you.
